title: neurocalyx borneensis var. typicus
intro: Neurocalyx borneensis var. typicus, commonly known as Borneo Neurocalyx, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Southeast Asian folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its rich profile of bioactive constituents. The health benefits of Borneo Neurocalyx include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Borneo Neurocalyx include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
